mapper.sql: namespace_id AS namespaceId, application_id AS applicationId, namespace_code AS namespaceCode, namespace_name AS namespaceName, description, sort_order AS sortOrder, version, created_by AS createdBy, updated_by AS updatedBy, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_i18n_namespace (namespace_id, application_id, namespace_code, namespace_name, description, sort_order, version, created_by, updated_by, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{row.namespaceId}, #{row.applicationId}, #{row.namespaceCode}, #{row.namespaceName}, #{row.description}, #{row.sortOrder}, #{row.version}, #{row.createdBy}, #{row.updatedBy}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_i18n_namespace WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} ORDER BY sort_order, namespace_code
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_i18n_namespace WHERE namespace_id = #{row.namespaceId} AND version = #{row.version}
